scope: Line badges only; no operator logos, stations, routes or line-color datasets changed.
method: Visually inspected every numbered line icon in Wikimedia Commons category Hangzhou Metro icons. Recreated geometry locally as SVG. Numerals are stored as local outline paths from natural Arial (single digit) and Arial Narrow (two digits), with no nonuniform scaling, so font fallback cannot cause overlap. Chinese/English captions use natural text. These are layout recreations, not original operator artwork.

sources.kind: Official Shaoxing Metro network map, published 2026-07-22, includes Hangzhou and Hanghai

limitations: Original Wikimedia SVG downloads were rate-limited. Source shapes and lettering hierarchy were checked from rendered icon previews; local type may differ slightly from outlined originals.
The Hanghai plaque uses the official network map English wording rather than the former invented Hanghai Intercity caption.
